note: Prompts deliberately differ from the agent's description wording. Two positives are questions. Negatives are near misses owned by other agents: a diff review (swift-reviewer), a dead-code request (dead-code-finder), a single bug fix, and a one-function question.

prompts.prompt: I'm about to start a big cleanup of this app. Before I touch anything, go through the whole codebase and tell me what's over-engineered, what's repeated, and where the tests are thin.
Which parts of this project would hurt the most if I started simplifying them tomorrow? Walk the whole thing, not one file.
How healthy is this codebase overall? I want a read on structure, complexity and test coverage before the next release.
Do a full architecture and maintainability pass over the app and rank the cleanup work by how safe it is.
Look over the diff from my last commit and tell me if I broke anything in the Swift.
Is there anything in this repo that nothing calls anymore? I want to delete what's unused.
The plan import throws a bad-row error on a file that looks fine to me. Find the bug and fix it.
What does PlateCalculator.platesPerSide give back for a 100 kg target?
